description: Send files or folders to a person's browser, or to another agent, through Files Direct. It opens a room and returns a link and a nine-digit code at once; give them to the person. The files go from this computer straight to the other device when it connects, and are never stored on our servers. The person on the other side is asked before anything is sent. Only files and folders inside the folders this server was started with can be sent, and folders that hold keys or passwords never can. The transfer goes on in the background: follow it with transfer_status.

password.description: A password the other side has to type before it can join. Recommended when the room is shared by code.

paths.description: Files or folders to send, as paths on this computer. A folder is sent with everything inside it, keeping its folders. Relative paths start from the first allowed folder.

name: send_files
title: Send files
